referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The official Roto-Rooter plumbing and drain services homepage was inspected in paired desktop and mobile full-page captures. The page opens with a pale-lavender split stage pairs a service van and technician with a large phone number and ZIP finder. It uses stacked utility navigation with a location action, service menus, and a red schedule button. The visual system relies on condensed uppercase sans headings with plain sans explanations; surfaces include lavender gray, white, deep purple and accents include service red, pale lavender. Imagery is documentary van and technician photographs, followed by service and customer scenes. The page then runs through utility navigation, split service hero, diagonal purple service grid, technician and trust explanation, question and video chapters, review band, contact footer. Its service presentation is four illustrated service tiles for urgent plumbing, water damage, drains, and water heaters. Mobile changes to stack the van above the contact finder, convert service tiles to a narrow sequence, and retain a visible call action. Transfer only the layout rhythm and decision path. Do not copy uniforms, vans, slogans, review cards, phone number, service guarantees, or employee portraits.
